I thought I would just throw my loot filter out for other people to use if they want.

Show
BaseType Flask Quality >= 10
Show
LinkedSockets > 4
Show
SocketGroup RGB
Show
Sockets 6
Show
Class Jewel "Quest Items" "Stackable Currency" Maps "Map Fragments" "Fishing Rods" "Divination Card" Gems
Show
BaseType "Agate Amulet" "Two-Stone Ring"
Hide
Rarity < Rare

What you will get: - All flasks 10%+Q - All items with more than 4 sockets linked - All items with red, blue, green links - All jewels - All Quest Items - All currency items - All maps - All map fragments - All fishing rods, if they even drop anymore - All new cards - All Gems - All Agate Amulets AND two-stone rings - All Rare items, regardless of level
Where does one put this info? I've never used a loot filter so I don't know.

Open the folder located at C:\Users(YOUR USER NAME)\Documents\My Games\Path of Exile, you should be able to see a file called "production_Config.ini". If you do create a NEW TEXT DOCUMENT, paste the text above into the file then save it. You must change the file extension from .txt to .filter, if you do not see a file extension the production_Config OR the new text document you have to change your windows folder options in your control panel, the option you are looking for is called "hide extensions on known file types" you want that to be OFF!
